s: A company's CFO needs a directional business case within 2 weeks to decide whether to migrate 2,500 VMware VMs to AWS. The infrastructure team already has a recent RVTools export from vCenter with VM configuration and utilization data. The company does not want to install agents or deploy data collectors yet. The projection must include right-sized Amazon EC2 recommendations and estimated costs under different purchase options. Which approach will produce the business case with the LEAST effort?
o: Upload the RVTools export to an AWS Transform assessment, and use the generated business case with right-sized EC2 recommendations and cost projections for different purchase options.
Deploy the AWS Application Discovery Service Agentless Collector in vCenter, and build the business case from the data in AWS Migration Hub.
Enter each VM into AWS Pricing Calculator by using the vCPU and memory allocations from vCenter.
Import the RVTools export into AWS Compute Optimizer to generate rightsizing recommendations and costs.

w.y: AWS Transform assessments accept existing inventory exports such as RVTools and generate a business case with right-sized EC2 recommendations and cost projections. Reusing data the team already has, with no agents or collectors, is the LEAST effort.

o.A: Correct: reuses existing data and produces a business case with no deployment.
o.B: Application Discovery Service and Migration Hub are closed to new customers, and this deploys a collector.
o.C: High manual effort, and allocated sizes are not right-sized from utilization.
o.D: Compute Optimizer analyzes only resources already running in AWS; it cannot import on-premises inventories.

d: LEAST effort; does not want to install agents or deploy data collectors
